title: FlowTable consumption and HTTP message rendering
answers: How does the flow view render HTTP request/response?
What does FlowTable select from Redux?
Why does the # column keep original number after sort?
body:
- `components/FlowTable.tsx` connect(...) selects `flows.view`, `highlightedIds`, `selectedIds`, `_listIndex`, first selected index (from `_viewIndex`), and `options.web_columns` once at table level (commit d482bbaa2 reduced per-row subscriptions). `_listIndex` feeds the `#` column so numbers persist through sort/filter.
- `components/FlowView.tsx` imports `Request`/`Response` from `components/FlowView/HttpMessages.tsx`; they read `state.flows.selected[0]` via useAppSelector and render memoized `Message`, using `RequestLine` etc. editors and `KeyValueListEditor`.
- Body rendering delegates to `components/contentviews/HttpMessage.tsx` (uses useContentView, useContent, ViewSelector, ContentRenderer, CodeEditor; `setContentViewFor` from `ducks/ui/flow`).
